WITH relevant_movies AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT DISTINCT mk.movie_id
    FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
    WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM movie_companies AS mc
          JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
          WHERE mc.movie_id = mk.movie_id
      )
),
relevant_names AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT n.id, n.name
    FROM name AS n
    WHERE n.name LIKE '%B%'
)
SELECT MIN(n.name) AS member_in_charnamed_movie
FROM relevant_names AS n
JOIN cast_info AS ci ON ci.person_id = n.id
JOIN title AS t ON t.id = ci.movie_id
JOIN relevant_movies AS rm ON rm.movie_id = t.id
JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON mk.movie_id = t.id
JOIN keyword AS k ON k.id = mk.keyword_id
JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON mc.movie_id = t.id
JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id
WHERE k.keyword = 'character-name-in-title'
